title: Part 3 Practice: Migration, Age/Sex Structure, and Population Distribution

questions.text: Study the diagram below showing migration types in Ethiopia. Which type is represented by the arrow from rural to urban areas?

diagram.content:
<svg width="300" height="150" viewBox="0 0 300 150">
                    <rect width="300" height="150" fill="#111827" rx="8"/>
                    <rect x="20" y="30" width="80" height="50" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#14b8a6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="35" y="55" fill="#14b8a6" font-size="8">Rural</text>
                    <text x="35" y="68" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">Areas</text>
                    <rect x="200" y="30" width="80" height="50" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f43f5e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="215" y="55" fill="#f43f5e" font-size="8">Urban</text>
                    <text x="215" y="68" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">Areas</text>
                    <line x1="100" y1="55" x2="195" y2="55" stroke="#facc15" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4"/>
                    <polygon points="195,50 210,55 195,60" fill="#facc15"/>
                    <text x="130" y="45" fill="#facc15" font-size="7">Migration</text>
                    <text x="30" y="120" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="7">Rural-Urban Migration</text>
                    <text x="30" y="135" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="7">Most common type in Ethiopia</text>
                </svg>

questions.explanation: Correct: The diagram shows movement from rural to urban areas, which is rural-urban migration. A is wrong—the arrow shows rural to urban, not urban to urban. C is wrong—the arrow shows rural to urban, not rural to rural. D is wrong—seasonal migration is temporary, not permanent.

questions.text: Based on the population pyramid diagram below, approximately what percentage of Ethiopia's population is under 15 years old?

diagram.content:
<svg width="300" height="150" viewBox="0 0 300 150">
                    <rect width="300" height="150" fill="#111827" rx="8"/>
                    <text x="100" y="20" fill="#facc15" font-size="8">Ethiopia's Population Pyramid</text>
                    <!-- Male side (left) -->
                    <rect x="80" y="30" width="40" height="10" fill="#38bdf8"/>
                    <rect x="80" y="45" width="35" height="10" fill="#38bdf8"/>
                    <rect x="80" y="60" width="25" height="10" fill="#38bdf8"/>
                    <rect x="80" y="75" width="15" height="10" fill="#38bdf8"/>
                    <rect x="80" y="90" width="8" height="10" fill="#38bdf8"/>
                    <!-- Female side (right) -->
                    <rect x="180" y="30" width="40" height="10" fill="#f43f5e"/>
                    <rect x="185" y="45" width="35" height="10" fill="#f43f5e"/>
                    <rect x="190" y="60" width="25" height="10" fill="#f43f5e"/>
                    <rect x="195" y="75" width="15" height="10" fill="#f43f5e"/>
                    <rect x="197" y="90" width="8" height="10" fill="#f43f5e"/>
                    <text x="55" y="38" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="6">Male</text>
                    <text x="210" y="38" fill="#f43f5e" font-size="6">Female</text>
                    <text x="45" y="115" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="6">0-14 yrs: 40%</text>
                    <text x="45" y="130" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="6">15-64 yrs: 55%</text>
                    <text x="45" y="145" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="6">65+ yrs: 5%</text>
                    <text x="190" y="115" fill="#facc15" font-size="6">Young Population</text>
                    <text x="190" y="130" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="6">Broad base</text>
                </svg>

questions.explanation: Correct: The pyramid shows 40% under 15 years (broad base). A is wrong—the diagram shows 40%, not 25%. C is wrong—55% is working age. D is wrong—65% is too high.

questions.text: Which measure of population distribution is shown in the calculation below? Population Density = Total Population / Total Land Area

diagram.content:
<svg width="300" height="150" viewBox="0 0 300 150">
                    <rect width="300" height="150" fill="#111827" rx="8"/>
                    <rect x="20" y="20" width="260" height="110" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#14b8a6" stroke-width="1"/>
                    <text x="80" y="40" fill="#facc15" font-size="9">Population Density Calculation</text>
                    <text x="40" y="60" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="8">Population Density = Total Population ÷ Total Land Area</text>
                    <text x="40" y="80" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="8">Example: Ethiopia</text>
                    <text x="40" y="95" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">Population: 120,000,000</text>
                    <text x="40" y="110" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">Land Area: 1,104,300 km²</text>
                    <text x="40" y="125" fill="#f59e0b" font-size="7">= ~110 people/km²</text>
                </svg>

questions.explanation: Correct: Crude density uses total population divided by total land area. A is wrong—physiographical density uses arable land. B is wrong—agricultural density uses agricultural population. D is wrong—economic density is not a standard measure.

questions.text: The diagram below shows push and pull factors. Which of the following is a PUSH factor shown in the diagram?

diagram.content:
<svg width="300" height="150" viewBox="0 0 300 150">
                    <rect width="300" height="150" fill="#111827" rx="8"/>
                    <text x="100" y="20" fill="#facc15" font-size="8">Migration Factors</text>
                    <!-- Push Factors -->
                    <rect x="20" y="30" width="120" height="100" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f43f5e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="40" y="48" fill="#f43f5e" font-size="8" font-weight="bold">PUSH Factors</text>
                    <text x="30" y="63" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• Poverty</text>
                    <text x="30" y="78" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• Land scarcity</text>
                    <text x="30" y="93" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• Conflict</text>
                    <text x="30" y="108" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• Drought</text>
                    <text x="30" y="123" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• Limited services</text>
                    <!-- Pull Factors -->
                    <rect x="160" y="30" width="120" height="100" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#14b8a6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="180" y="48" fill="#14b8a6" font-size="8" font-weight="bold">PULL Factors</text>
                    <text x="170" y="63" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• Employment</text>
                    <text x="170" y="78" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• Education</text>
                    <text x="170" y="93" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• Health services</text>
                    <text x="170" y="108" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• Family reunion</text>
                    <text x="170" y="123" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• Better infrastructure</text>
                </svg>

options: C) Land scarcity and environmental degradation
questions.correct_answer: C) Land scarcity and environmental degradation
questions.explanation: Correct: Land scarcity is a push factor shown in the diagram. A is wrong—this is a pull factor. B is wrong—this is a pull factor. D is wrong—this is a pull factor.

<svg width="300" height="150" viewBox="0 0 300 150">

                    <text x="35" y="48" fill="#f43f5e" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Youth</text>

                    <text x="35" y="78" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">40%</text>
                    <text x="35" y="95" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="6">Dependency</text>
                    <text x="35" y="108" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="6">~80-85/100</text>
                    
                    <rect x="110" y="30" width="80" height="80" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#14b8a6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="125" y="48" fill="#14b8a6" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Working</text>
                    <text x="125" y="63" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">15-64 yrs</text>
                    <text x="125" y="78" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">55%</text>
                    <text x="125" y="95" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="6">Dependents</text>
                    <text x="125" y="108" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="6">per 100</text>
                    
                    <rect x="200" y="30" width="80" height="80" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="1.5"/>

                    <text x="215" y="63" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">65+ yrs</text>
                    <text x="215" y="78" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">5%</text>

questions.explanation: Correct: Total dependency ratio is ~85-90. A is wrong—too low. B is wrong—slightly low. D is wrong—too high.

questions.text: The diagram below shows different density measures. Which measure specifically uses arable land in its calculation?

diagram.content:
<svg width="300" height="150" viewBox="0 0 300 150">
                    <rect width="300" height="150" fill="#111827" rx="8"/>
                    <text x="80" y="20" fill="#facc15" font-size="8">Population Density Measures</text>
                    
                    <rect x="15" y="30" width="85" height="45" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f43f5e" stroke-width="1"/>
                    <text x="25" y="45" fill="#f43f5e" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Crude Density</text>
                    <text x="20" y="58" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">Total Pop. / Total Area</text>
                    <text x="20" y="68" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="6">~110/km²</text>
                    
                    <rect x="110" y="30" width="85" height="45" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="1"/>
                    <text x="120" y="45" fill="#f59e0b" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Physiographical</text>
                    <text x="115" y="58" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">Total Pop. / Arable Land</text>
                    <text x="115" y="68" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="6">Higher than crude</text>
                    
                    <rect x="205" y="30" width="85" height="45" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#14b8a6" stroke-width="1"/>
                    <text x="215" y="45" fill="#14b8a6" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Agricultural</text>
                    <text x="210" y="58" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">Farmers / Arable Land</text>
                    <text x="210" y="68" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="6">Varies by region</text>
                    
                    <text x="30" y="120" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="7">Physiographical density measures pressure on agricultural land</text>
                    <text x="30" y="135" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="7">Important for food security planning</text>
                </svg>

questions.explanation: Correct: Physiographical density uses arable land. A is wrong—crude density uses total land. C is wrong—urban density is for cities. D is wrong—population density is general.

questions.text: Based on the population distribution map diagram, approximately what percentage of Ethiopia's population lives in the highlands?

diagram.content:
<svg width="300" height="150" viewBox="0 0 300 150">
                    <rect width="300" height="150" fill="#111827" rx="8"/>
                    <text x="100" y="20" fill="#facc15" font-size="8">Population Distribution in Ethiopia</text>
                    
                    <!-- Highland area -->
                    <rect x="20" y="30" width="150" height="80" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#14b8a6" stroke-width="2"/>
                    <text x="50" y="50" fill="#14b8a6" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Highlands</text>
                    <text x="35" y="65" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• 40% of land area</text>
                    <text x="35" y="80" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• 80-85% of population</text>
                    <text x="35" y="95" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="7">• High density</text>
                    
                    <!-- Lowland area -->
                    <rect x="180" y="30" width="100" height="80" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f43f5e" stroke-width="2"/>
                    <text x="195" y="50" fill="#f43f5e" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Lowlands</text>
                    <text x="190" y="65" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• 60% of land area</text>
                    <text x="190" y="80" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• 15-20% of pop.</text>
                    <text x="190" y="95" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="7">• Low density</text>
                    
                    <text x="30" y="135" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="7">Highland areas: Favorable climate, fertile soils, better infrastructure</text>
                </svg>

questions.explanation: Correct: About 80-85% of the population lives in the highlands. A is wrong—too low. B is wrong—too low. D is wrong—too high.

questions.text: Why is Ethiopia's physiographical density higher than its crude density?

diagram.content:
<svg width="300" height="150" viewBox="0 0 300 150">
                    <rect width="300" height="150" fill="#111827" rx="8"/>
                    <text x="70" y="20" fill="#facc15" font-size="8">Density Comparison</text>
                    
                    <rect x="20" y="30" width="120" height="45" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#14b8a6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="35" y="45" fill="#14b8a6" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Crude Density</text>
                    <text x="30" y="58" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">Total Pop. / Total Land</text>
                    <text x="30" y="70" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">= ~110 people/km²</text>
                    
                    <rect x="20" y="85" width="120" height="45" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="35" y="100" fill="#f59e0b" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Physiographical Density</text>
                    <text x="30" y="113" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">Total Pop. / Arable Land</text>
                    <text x="30" y="125" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">= ~200+ people/km²</text>
                    
                    <text x="160" y="45" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="7">Why higher?</text>
                    <text x="160" y="60" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• Much land is not arable</text>
                    <text x="160" y="75" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• Deserts, mountains</text>
                    <text x="160" y="90" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• Only 20-25% is arable</text>
                    <text x="160" y="105" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="7">Population concentrated</text>
                    <text x="160" y="118" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="7">on productive land</text>
                </svg>

options: A) There is more land than people
B) Much of the land is not arable (desert, mountains, etc.)
questions.correct_answer: B) Much of the land is not arable (desert, mountains, etc.)
questions.explanation: Correct: Physiographical density uses only arable land, which is less than total land. A is wrong—there is still land pressure. C is wrong—population is growing. D is wrong—urban growth doesn't explain this.

questions.text: The diagram below illustrates the demographic dividend. What does it represent for Ethiopia?

diagram.content:
<svg width="300" height="150" viewBox="0 0 300 150">
                    <rect width="300" height="150" fill="#111827" rx="8"/>
                    <text x="80" y="20" fill="#facc15" font-size="8">Demographic Dividend</text>
                    
                    <rect x="20" y="30" width="260" height="50" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="40" y="45" fill="#f59e0b" font-size="8" font-weight="bold">Large Working-Age Population</text>
                    <text x="40" y="58" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• 55-56% of population is 15-64 years</text>
                    <text x="40" y="70" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• Potential for economic growth</text>
                    
                    <rect x="20" y="90" width="260" height="40" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#14b8a6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="40" y="105" fill="#14b8a6" font-size="8" font-weight="bold">Requirements for Dividend</text>
                    <text x="40" y="118" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">Education • Employment • Investment • Good Governance</text>
                    
                    <text x="30" y="145" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="7">If properly managed, the youth population can drive development</text>
                </svg>

options: A) The aging of the population
B) The potential economic benefit from having a large working-age population
C) The decline in fertility rates
questions.correct_answer: B) The potential economic benefit from having a large working-age population
questions.explanation: Correct: The demographic dividend is economic growth potential from a large working-age population. A is wrong—Ethiopia has a young population. C is wrong—fertility decline is a cause, not the dividend itself. D is wrong—migration is not the dividend.
